CHAPTER XXXVII  
 
 
 
  Bezaleel and Aholiab make the ark, 1-5. 
  The mercy-seat, 6. 
  The two cherubim, 7-9. 
  The table of the shew-bread, and its vessels, 10-16. 
  The candlestick, 17-24. 
  The golden altar of incense, 25-28. 
  The holy anointing oil and perfume, 29.
